timing: after one apparatus smoke trial (held_out seed 1001), before main data collection
observation_that_prompted_it: In the smoke trial every protocol, including solo, ended identically (no success; tolerant sets of 750 and 305 candidates unchanged over 4 rounds). Diagnosis: a per-position value mask over hundreds of candidates admits every value at every position, so the packets carried no usable information. This is an encoding defect common to all protocols, not a difference between them.
change: The 'candidate mask' exchanged at the twist, and carried, is the pairwise mask: for each of the 15 position pairs, the 25-bit set of value combinations present among the sender's candidates. Payload = 15 x 25 bits = 375 bits = 47 raw bytes, inside the unchanged 48-byte budget.
measurement_clarified: max_packet_payload_bytes counts raw payload bits rounded up to bytes, not JSON transport encoding.
unchanged: hypotheses, protocols' definitions, rounds, budgets, task sets, seeds, analysis, invalidation rule, interpretation limits
smoke_trial_status: not counted in results; seed 1001 remains in the held_out set and is rerun under the amended encoding like every other task
